chain.name: child terminal completion
chain.input_schema: runner result plus terminal status and captured session routing
chain.output_schema: type=async_delegation event with delegation_id, session_key, origin_session_id, parent_session_id, status, summary/error and timestamps
chain.profile_touched: current Hermes home/profile inherited by worker context
chain.failure_behavior: logs queue/persistence failure; result remains queryable only if persistence succeeded
chain.retry_behavior: pending durable row is restored after restart
chain.idempotency_behavior: delegation_id is durable identity; delivery is at-least-once

chain.name: completion restore
chain.input_schema: non-running async_delegations rows with pending delivery_state and event_json
chain.profile_touched: only the process current Hermes home
chain.failure_behavior: ownership must be positively proven; restored ownerless events are left queued
chain.idempotency_behavior: durable claim prevents competing consumers from accepting the same row

chain.name: claim and target validation
chain.input_schema: formatted synthetic text plus async event
chain.output_schema: True accepted, False retry, None terminal/duplicate/no route
chain.database_touched: async_delegations claim/attempt/ack; session DB target lookup
chain.queue_touched: yes; event is requeued on retry
chain.profile_touched: current GatewayRunner profile scope; no event profile field
chain.failure_behavior: missing/explicitly ended parent fails closed; transient lookup releases claim
chain.retry_behavior: stale claim recovery and bounded attempt cap; dropped rows remain queryable
chain.idempotency_behavior: SQLite claim plus in-process producer identity ledger

chain.name: parent session resolution
chain.database_touched: session DB reads and routing switch
chain.failure_behavior: unknown, explicit /new-ended, or unowned lineage is dropped
chain.retry_behavior: handled by outer delivery claim only for transient preflight uncertainty
chain.idempotency_behavior: pinned session and compression lineage prevent route drift

chain.name: synthetic turn construction
chain.input_schema: bounded formatted completion text, source routing, optional gateway_session_id metadata
chain.output_schema: adapter acceptance or HTTP completion request
chain.runtime_owner: parent GatewayRunner for push adapters; API server for stateless self-post
chain.database_touched: not by construction; normal turn later persists messages
chain.profile_touched: source/profile runtime scope selected by parent backend; API self-post defaults to adapter scope
chain.transport_dependency: live adapter/event loop for push; authenticated localhost HTTP for API server
chain.failure_behavior: no route returns None; adapter failure returns False; self-post raises after bounded retry
chain.retry_behavior: outer native completion requeues; API self-post retries 429/network errors
chain.idempotency_behavior: native durable claim and delivery identity; no AOTA event identity consumed here

chain.name: normal parent turn execution
chain.input_schema: MessageEvent text with internal=True and optional gateway_session_id
chain.output_schema: assistant final response, persisted session messages, normal stream/send
chain.runtime_owner: parent backend agent and event loop
chain.database_touched: session DB appends user and assistant messages via AIAgent._flush_messages_to_session_db
chain.session_touched: yes; new user-role turn and assistant response in target history
chain.profile_touched: profile runtime scope selected before AIAgent creation
chain.failure_behavior: normal agent/adapter failure handling; stale route suppresses response
chain.retry_behavior: normal model/provider retry and gateway delivery behavior, not native completion retry
chain.idempotency_behavior: message persistence markers prevent repeated DB appends; end-to-end delivery remains at-least-once

chain.name: stream publication and delivery acknowledgement
chain.input_schema: assistant deltas/final response and accepted synthetic turn
chain.output_schema: normal platform stream plus durable completion ack
chain.database_touched: async_delegations ack after adapter acceptance; session DB from normal turn
chain.session_touched: assistant response persisted by normal agent path
chain.failure_behavior: ack is not claimed if injection is not accepted; failure releases claim
chain.retry_behavior: pending row reappears on later watcher/restart
chain.idempotency_behavior: claim token and delivery identity; no exactly-once guarantee

final_synthetic_turn_finding: There is no standalone session-manager append_and_run_turn public function. The effective final construction point is _inject_watch_notification (or gateway.wake.deliver_wake), and it enters the normal MessageEvent/adapter pipeline. The native watcher itself is the async_delegation service/gateway layer, not the CLI or Desktop frontend.
